ab-testing.description: Plan A/B tests and growth experiments: hypotheses, variants, measurement, sample size, duration, and an experiment backlog.

ad-creative.description: Create and iterate paid ad copy, hooks, headlines, and visual or video concepts; prepare creative tests and approval-ready variations.

ads.description: Plan and optimize paid campaigns: audiences, budgets, bidding, retargeting, ABM, ROAS, CPA, CAC payback, and lead quality across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.

ai-seo.description: Improve AI search visibility, LLM citations, AEO/GEO, AI Overviews, and agent-readable site content; audit why AI answers overlook your brand.

analytics.description: Set up or audit GA4, conversion events, UTMs, tag managers, and tracking plans; diagnose missing events and measure marketing results.

aso.description: Audit and optimize App Store or Google Play listings, app keywords, visibility, rankings, and listing conversion.

attribution.description: Choose attribution models, reconcile revenue dashboards, and investigate channel impact using multi-touch, MMM, incrementality, and first-party attribution.

churn-prevention.description: Reduce subscriber churn with cancellation flows, save offers, retention, failed-payment recovery, dunning, pauses, and win-back strategies.

co-marketing.description: Find co-marketing partners and plan joint campaigns, integration marketing, co-branded content, and cross-promotions.

cold-email.description: Write and run cold outbound: emails and follow-ups, sending domains and deliverability, LinkedIn steps, multichannel cadences, call handoffs, and replies.

community-marketing.description: Plan or grow a user community, forum, Discord, or Slack group; develop engagement, advocates, ambassadors, and community-led growth.

competitor-profiling.description: Research competitors from URLs and build structured profiles, competitive intelligence, landscape analyses, and dossiers. Not for accounts you sell to.

competitors.description: Create or audit buyer-facing competitor comparison, versus, and alternative pages; verify existing positioning claims and competitive assets.

content-strategy.description: Plan content topics, pillars, clusters, editorial calendars, blog strategy, and content roadmaps before writing individual pieces.

copy-editing.description: Review, polish, tighten, or refresh existing marketing copy; remove awkward wording, stale content, and AI writing patterns.

copywriting.description: Write or rewrite website marketing copy: homepages, landing pages, product pages, headlines, CTAs, and value propositions.

cro.description: Audit marketing pages and lead-capture forms to improve conversions; diagnose landing-page friction, form abandonment, and weak conversion rates.

customer-research.description: Plan or analyze customer interviews, surveys, support tickets, reviews, and online research; identify ICP, jobs to be done, and voice of customer.

directory-submissions.description: Plan and track product submissions to startup, SaaS, AI, agent, MCP, and review directories for discovery and backlinks.

emails.description: Create or optimize lifecycle email programs: welcome, onboarding, nurture, drip, re-engagement, and automated multi-email sequences. Not cold outreach.

events.description: Plan webinars, conferences, trade shows, meetups, dinners, and speaking; evaluate sponsorships, event ROI, attendance, and follow-up.

free-tools.description: Plan, evaluate, or build free calculators, generators, graders, and interactive tools for lead generation, SEO, or brand awareness.

image.description: Create or optimize marketing images: blog heroes, product mockups, social graphics, banners, listing visuals, and brand assets.

influencer-marketing.description: Find and vet creators, influencers, and ambassadors; plan sponsorship deals, briefs, disclosure, UGC partnerships, and ROI measurement.

launch.description: Plan launches and announcements: betas, waitlists, Product Hunt, site go-live QA, and turning shipped changes into changelogs and announcement drafts.

lead-magnets.description: Plan lead magnets and content offers: ebooks, checklists, templates, gating, landing pages, and packaging a course or content library as an installable agent skill.

marketing-council.description: Explore a marketing question through multiple documented expert frameworks; compare simulated advisor perspectives and synthesize their disagreements.

marketing-ideas.description: Brainstorm marketing tactics, growth ideas, and channel strategies for a SaaS or software product when deciding what to try next.

marketing-loops.description: Design recurring agent-run marketing loops: weekly reviews, SEO and outbound operators, signal sweeps, reply triage, ad fatigue, churn and content decay.

marketing-plan.description: Create a comprehensive AARRR marketing plan, current-state audit, market sizing, budget, operating stack, and growth roadmap.

marketing-psychology.description: Apply behavioral science, persuasion, mental models, cognitive biases, framing, social proof, and decision-making principles to marketing.

offers.description: Design service, agency, course, or high-ticket offers: value framing, bonuses, guarantees, naming, scarcity, and payment structure.

onboarding.description: Optimize post-signup activation, setup, first-run experience, empty states, aha moments, and time to value.

paywalls.description: Improve in-app paywalls, upgrade prompts, feature gates, trial-expiry screens, and freemium-to-paid conversion.

popups.description: Optimize lead-capture popups, exit-intent overlays, modals, announcement banners, sticky bars, and interrupt-style conversion elements.

pricing.description: Choose pricing, tiers, value metrics, freemium, trials, and packaging; audit pricing pages for buyers and AI readability.

product-marketing.description: Create or update product marketing context, positioning, audience, ICP, and foundational information shared across marketing tasks.

programmatic-seo.description: Plan or build SEO pages at scale: templates, directories, locations, comparisons, integrations, and choosing a CMS or platform that can publish them.

prospecting.description: Build and qualify prospect lists: ICP, buying signals, enrichment waterfalls, email verification and catch-alls, account tiers, and pre-outreach research.

public-relations.description: Plan earned media, journalist pitches, press materials, podcast appearances, thought leadership, and crisis communications.

referrals.description: Design or improve referral, affiliate, and partner programs, plus review programs: getting more reviews, responding to them, and reusing testimonials.

revops.description: Improve lead scoring, routing, CRM hygiene, lifecycle and outbound pipeline stages, deal processes, and marketing-to-sales handoffs.

sales-enablement.description: Create sales decks, proposals, one-pagers, battle cards, demo and cold call scripts, objection handling, and deal-specific ROI or win-loss analysis.

schema.description: Implement or fix schema.org JSON-LD and structured data for products, reviews, breadcrumbs, FAQs, and eligible search enhancements.

seo-audit.description: Audit SEO: crawling, indexing, rankings, traffic drops, page speed, title tags, pages stuck on page 2, and local SEO for Business Profiles and the map pack.

signup.description: Optimize registration, account creation, free-trial signup, signup forms, friction, abandonment, and completion rates.

site-architecture.description: Plan website structure: hierarchy, navigation, URLs, sitemaps, internal linking, choosing a website platform, and migrating without losing traffic.

sms.description: Plan SMS, MMS, and WhatsApp campaigns, lifecycle texts, transactional messages, opt-ins, templates, and messaging compliance.

social.description: Create, repurpose, or schedule social posts, carousels, and short-video scripts; plan social strategy, listening, and engagement triage.

video.description: Plan and produce AI or programmatic marketing videos, avatars, explainers, product demos, templates, and reference-style edits.
